audience: community managers who run a member community on Bettermode

useCases.title: Check community size and basic details
useCases.text: The AI reads the network: name, domain, status, creation date and total member count. You get a short status of the community.

useCases.title: Find a member by name, username or email
useCases.text: The AI searches members by a search term or role and reads one member's role, status, creation date and tagline. You find who a person is and when they joined.

useCases.title: Review the newest posts in the spaces
useCases.text: The AI lists posts across the community or in chosen spaces, newest first, with title, short content, space and owner. It sums up what members talk about.

useCases.title: Search the community for a topic
useCases.text: The AI runs a full-text search over members, spaces and posts and groups the hits by type. You see where a topic like refunds comes up.

useCases.title: List the spaces and what each one holds
useCases.text: The AI lists spaces by name and reads one space by id or slug, with description, type and member and post counts. You see which spaces are busy.
